description: This file contains a complex implementation of a converter that transforms TorchScript graphs into FX GraphModules, including support for various node types, control flow, and attribute lifting. It also includes classes for explanation and retracing, as well as utilities for handling external references and operator schemas.

classes.name: TS2FXGraphConverter
classes.description: Converts TorchScript graphs into FX GraphModules, handling various node types, attributes, and control flow constructs.

classes.name: ExplainTS2FXGraphConverter
classes.description: Extends TS2FXGraphConverter to collect unsupported nodes and provide explanations of conversion issues.

classes.name: TS2EPConverter
classes.description: Main class to convert TorchScript models into ExportedProgram, including tracing, lifting attributes, and retracing.

methods.name: _create_jit_graph
methods.description: Creates a TorchScript graph from a model and arguments, handling scripting and tracing.

methods.description: Appends an element to a list.

methods.name: execute_subgraph_from_prim_loop
methods.description: Executes a subgraph within a prim::Loop construct.

methods.name: inplace_optimize_sym_size_div
methods.description: Replaces pattern in FX graph for size division optimization.

methods.name: is_valid_for_codegen
methods.description: Checks if a name is valid for code generation.

methods.name: normalize_name
methods.description: Normalizes a name by replacing dots and adding prefix if needed.

methods.name: ir_name_to_func_name
methods.description: Converts IR node kind to a function name for handler dispatch.

methods.name: get_node_as_placeholder_or_get_attr
methods.description: Retrieves a placeholder or get_attr node from FX graph based on context.

methods.name: get_dtype_as_int
methods.description: Maps tensor dtype to an integer enum.

methods.name: get_op_overload
methods.description: Retrieves the operator overload from torch.ops based on node schema.

methods.name: get_attribute_fqn_from_ts_node
methods.description: Constructs the fully qualified name of an attribute from a TorchScript node.

methods.name: construct_fqn
methods.description: Builds a full name from reference maps.

methods.name: get_block_to_lifted_attrs
methods.description: Analyzes a graph to determine which attributes need to be lifted into subgraphs.
